notes: Canonical intent labels shared by Branch A, Branch B, the dispatcher and the evaluation tools. Do not add per-course intents: course, weekday and location are slots.

intents.label: help
intents.description: The student asks what Pepper can do.
intents.en_hypothesis: This is a request for help or for what the assistant can do.

intents.label: ask_time
intents.description: The student asks for the current time.
intents.en_hypothesis: This asks what the current time is.

intents.label: ask_current_class
intents.description: The student asks which class is on right now.
intents.en_hypothesis: This asks which class is happening right now.

intents.label: ask_next_class
intents.description: The student asks which class is next.
intents.en_hypothesis: This asks what the next class is.

intents.label: ask_lecturer
intents.description: The student asks who lectures a course.
intents.en_hypothesis: This asks who the lecturer of a course is.

intents.label: ask_course_time
intents.description: The student asks when a course meets.
intents.en_hypothesis: This asks when a course takes place.

intents.label: ask_course_venue
intents.description: The student asks where a course is held.
intents.en_hypothesis: This asks where a course is held.

intents.label: ask_day_schedule
intents.description: The student asks for the timetable of a day (today if no weekday is given).
intents.en_hypothesis: This asks for the class timetable of a day.

intents.label: list_courses
intents.description: The student asks which courses are offered.
intents.en_hypothesis: This asks for the list of courses.

intents.label: ask_current_semester
intents.description: The student asks which semester it is.
intents.en_hypothesis: This asks which semester it currently is.

intents.label: open_self_service
intents.description: The student asks to open Wits Student Self-Service.
intents.en_hypothesis: This asks to open the student self-service portal.

intents.label: OOS
intents.description: Out of scope: anything the assistant does not support.
intents.en_hypothesis: This is about something unrelated to classes, time or self-service.

slots.course: Course code from data/courses.json, e.g. COMS9001. Filled from a spoken code or a course alias.
slots.weekday: monday ... sunday, or the relative values today / tomorrow.
slots.location: A venue name known to the timetable.
